svg.title: Insertion sort: one complete run with conditions and updates
svg.desc: Sort 7, 3, 5, 2 in three passes. Each pass shows i, the saved key, and initial j. Each while-condition check is evaluated before showing the resulting array write and j update. When j becomes -1 the boundary check fails, so arr[-1] is never read. In pass 2, 3 is not greater than key 5, so shifting stops and 5 is inserted at index 1. Orange outlines identify written cells; green cells form the sorted section after insertion. Final array: 2, 3, 5, 7.
svg.text: Keep key saved while checking and shifting larger values.
Orange outline = cell written. Green = sorted section.
j = -1: (-1 >= 0) is false. Stop; arr[j] is not read.
j = -1: (-1 >= 0) is false. Stop; arr[j] is not read.
